name: smwsprites-bob-omb-leaves-fire-trail
title: Bob-omb, Leaves Fire Trail
description:
A Bob-omb which leaves a fire trail every certain amount of time, controlled by the fourth extra byte.

Requested by Green during C3 Winter 2025. That one used the old, now-removed Bob-omb disassembly. This one uses my own disassembly as a base, now with X speed, time before being quiet, and time before exploding all parametrized in extra bytes.
